title: Railway v21 proof status hygiene and preserved external-game ownership boundary

findings.result: A fresh v21 Railway positive-row/Follow proof targeting server 2207 was attempted with the strict LiveManualFullRailwayProof. No process was closed, attached to, or hijacked.

Two stale current-guidance references to Truck/Dispatch state-changing Plunder acceptance were removed. Scheduled Truck/Dispatch Plunder remains retired by owner since R7-149; current authorization-gated state-changing guidance is limited to Treasure and Alliance.
